iconicAnchor.label: New York City Subway Directional Signage
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Massimo Vignelli, Bob Noorda, and MTA New York City Transit
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The sign demonstrates a coordinated environmental system using durable material, viewing-distance typography, direction, and institutional consistency.

sources.title: New York City Subway Directional Signage
supports: The work is a full environmental directional sign manufactured for a transit system.
Its scale and porcelain-enamel material distinguish wayfinding from a standalone icon sheet.

sources.title: Emergency Exit ISO Pictogram (green).svg
supports: The audited public-domain file demonstrates standardized public-information pictogram construction.
It supports icon consistency but requires wider environmental evidence to teach the full node.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches viewing distance, directional, standardized pictograms, color coded, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/civic-wayfinding/reference-01.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
